evals.prompt: Review this new skill for portable frontmatter and eval coverage gaps.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit with dispatch, references, eval, and packaging recommendations.
assertions: Agent stays read-only on skill files.
Agent recommends validate/audit commands without running live installs.

evals.prompt: Should this third-party skill live in skills/ or the curated catalog?
evals.expected_output: Routes to catalog authoring flow; does not vendor third-party trees into skills/.
assertions: Agent distinguishes repo-owned skills vs curated external catalog.
Agent cites AGENTS.md section 2.7 style workflow.
Agent does not copy external sources into skills/.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the skill body and commit it now.
evals.expected_output: Advisory output only unless user explicitly requests edits in session.
assertions: Agent honors read-only advisor role by default.
Agent may propose diffs or recommendations without applying.
